from openpyxl import load_workbook
src='/root/nasa_budget_incomplete.xlsx'; out='/root/nasa_budget_recovered.xlsx'
a=load_workbook(src); b=load_workbook(out, data_only=False)
targets={('Budget by Directorate','K5'),('Budget by Directorate','F8'),('Budget by Directorate','B9'),('Budget by Directorate','E10'),('Budget by Directorate','K10'),('Budget by Directorate','C12'),('YoY Changes (%)','D7'),('YoY Changes (%)','B9'),('YoY Changes (%)','F9'),('Directorate Shares (%)','F5'),('Directorate Shares (%)','B10'),('Growth Analysis','E4'),('Growth Analysis','E5'),('Growth Analysis','B7'),('Growth Analysis','B8')}
# Check all placeholders replaced and all other cell values/styles retained.
assert not any(c.value=='???' for ws in b for row in ws for c in row)
for oldws,newws in zip(a.worksheets,b.worksheets):
    assert oldws.title==newws.title and oldws.max_row==newws.max_row and oldws.max_column==newws.max_column
    for oldrow,newrow in zip(oldws.iter_rows(),newws.iter_rows()):
        for oldc,newc in zip(oldrow,newrow):
            if (oldws.title,oldc.coordinate) not in targets: assert oldc.value==newc.value, (oldws.title,oldc.coordinate)
            assert oldc.style_id==newc.style_id, (oldws.title,oldc.coordinate,'style')
# Cross-sheet arithmetic.
budget=b['Budget by Directorate']; yoy=b['YoY Changes (%)']; shares=b['Directorate Shares (%)']; growth=b['Growth Analysis']
for r in range(4,14):
    assert sum(budget.cell(r,c).value for c in range(2,11))==budget.cell(r,11).value, ('total',r)
for r in range(4,13):
    br=r+1
    for c in range(2,12):
        expected=round((budget.cell(br,c).value/budget.cell(br-1,c).value-1)*100,2)
        assert yoy.cell(r,c).value==expected, ('yoy',r,c,yoy.cell(r,c).value,expected)
for r in range(4,14):
    for c in range(2,11):
        expected=round(budget.cell(r,c).value/budget.cell(r,11).value*100,2)
        assert shares.cell(r,c).value==expected, ('share',r,c,shares.cell(r,c).value,expected)
for c in range(2,11):
    v19=budget.cell(8,c).value; v24=budget.cell(13,c).value
    assert growth.cell(5,c).value==v19
    assert growth.cell(6,c).value==v24
    assert growth.cell(7,c).value==v24-v19
    assert growth.cell(4,c).value==round(((v24/v19)**(1/5)-1)*100,2)
    expected_avg=round(sum(budget.cell(r,c).value for r in range(8,14))/6,1)
    assert growth.cell(8,c).value==expected_avg, ('avg',c,growth.cell(8,c).value,expected_avg)
print('PASS: 15 placeholders replaced; every annual total, YoY change, directorate share, and growth-analysis value recomputes exactly; non-target cells and styles are unchanged.')
